news.body:
## The week is one window a day
- Class runs 12:30 to 19:00 your time, today and every day to Friday.
That leaves your mornings, and only your mornings. The passport is dated today and you still do not know the centre's hours, so one call before you set off decides whether today is the window or Saturday is.
- Harver is the other thing that fits in a morning.
Kraft Heinz cannot see your results until that application is submitted, and nobody has put a date on it. It is the one open thing this week with nothing forcing it, which is how it gets to December.
## Club 8 is the only thing actually late
- Dated yesterday, untouched since the 9th, and nudged twice.
What is open is what the room comes with and when you can take the keys, and both are one email. Move-in is 3 January, which is why it has felt postponable and also why it will still be open at Christmas.
